title: Named canonical data for the integral point towers
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integer ring $\mathcal O_E$, as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Use the actual quotient and pullback towers, exact point sections and Roos one-minus-shift maps of [lem-trf-point-transport-cone-comparison-descent]. Define trfPointSectionsComplex to be its sections functor; trfPointSourceTower and trfPointTargetTower to be its reductionTowers and pullbackTowers; trfPointSourceEnd to be reductionEnd. Define the target and sheaf-target endomorphisms to be one minus the transition shift on the corresponding countable products. Finite index n denotes exponent n+1. Use the concrete small-Hom module derived-category instance obtained from the existing Grothendieck-abelian construction. These names denote the original evaluated quotient/pullback compositions and their actual product endomorphisms, without choosing new data.

source.place: clause *(3)*: the integral point transport is the derived limit of the levelwise maps, via its specified cone map; implementation module IntegralPointTransportTowerData

proof.text: The section functor is the same mapHomologicalComplex. Existing reductionTowers_eq_original and pullbackTowers_eq_original identify the canonical functors with the raw composed towers; reductionEnd is the same one-minus-shift map. The target maps retain their original bodies with explicit End result types. The localization alias retains the existing concrete constructor.

proof_origin.place: clause *(3)*: the integral point transport is the derived limit of the levelwise maps, via its specified cone map; implementation module IntegralPointTransportTowerData

mathlib_searches.query: exact evaluation of inverse towers commutes with the two-coordinate Roos mapping cocone, natural quotient augmentation, and finite Frobenius point transport
mathlib_searches.results: Generic limits and cocone comparison equations, tensor quotient maps, and inverse Frobenius on perfect rings; no coefficient-sheaf point construction. Existing project constructions are reused.
Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.HomotopyCategory.MappingCocone: mappingCocone, fst, snd, liftCochain and projection equations. These are the generic ingredients, not the specified integral point data.
Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.OfSequence supplies ofOpSequence and NatTrans.ofOpSequence. No specialized realization or finite point iterate; source constructions already exist in Sheaf.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no exact Mathlib match; reuse the project API
